stations.name: Union Station
stations.description: Union Station is the historical intercity rail station serving Denver. It was renovated in 1914 and 2014. The majority of RTD rail lines connect to Union Station.

stations.name: Denver Airport
stations.description: Denver Airport Station allows travelers to get to Denver Airport via transit. It has a special, higher fare zone specifically for travelers to and from the station. It has three art installations: Shadow Array by Patrick Marold, L’eau dans tous ses états by Yann Kersalé, and an informal installation of railroad ties in an unused area.

stations.name: Peoria
stations.description: Peoria Station is a junction on the A Line and serves as the northern terminus of the R Line. It is the first A Line connection to Aurora. It has an art installation named Biota by Blessing Hancock.

stations.name: I-25 / Broadway
stations.description: I-25 / Broadway Station was originally the southern terminus of the RTD rail network. During the Downtown Rail Reconstruction Project, it is served by the C, E, and temporary T Lines. It has three sculptures collectively titled The Welcoming Committee, created by Elaine Calzolari.

stations.name: 40th  / Airport - Gateway Park
stations.wikipedia: en:40th Ave & Airport Blvd–Gateway Park station
stations.description: 40th / Airport - Gateway Park Station serves Aurora. It has a large park-and-ride facility and an art installation, Time Present, by Molly Dilworth.

stations.name: Central Park
stations.description: Denver's Central Park Station serves the Park Hill and Central Park neighborhoods of Denver. It is near the former location of Stapleton International Airport. It has an art installation named Balloon Man Running created by Sean O'Meallie.

stations.name: Auraria West Campus
stations.description: Auraria West Campus Station serves the Auraria Campus, home to the Community College of Denver, Metropolitan State University of Denver, and the University of Colorado Denver.

stations.name: 16th & California
stations.description: 16th & California Station is one of two stations along 16th Street. It has no active rail service while the D, H, and L Lines are suspended.

stations.name: 16th & Stout
stations.description: 16th & Stout Station is one of two stations along 16th Street. It has no active rail service while the D, H, and L Lines are suspended.

stations.name: Alameda
stations.description: Alameda Station is near the Denver Design District and shops on Broadway St. It primarily serves a residential area.

stations.name: 18th & California
stations.description: 18th & California Station is one of two stations along 18th Street. It has no active rail service while the D, H, and L Lines are suspended.

stations.name: 18th & Stout
stations.description: 18th & Stout Station is one of two stations along 18th Street. It has no active rail service while the D, H, and L Lines are suspended.

stations.name: 10th / Osage
stations.description: 10th / Osage Station serves a residential area of Denver and is the northernmost station of the Central Corridor.

stations.name: Littleton-Mineral
stations.description: Littleton-Mineral Station serves as the southern terminus for the C Line, but RTD plans to extend the line south to Highlands Ranch.

stations.name: Colfax at Auraria
stations.description: Colfax at Auraria Station serves the east end of the Auraria Campus.

stations.name: 38th / Blake
stations.description: 38th / Blake Station serves the Five Points neighborhood of Denver, including RiNo. It has an art installation named Conflux/Redox by Kelton Osborn.

stations.name: 61st / Pena
stations.description: 61st / Peña Station is the final station before Denver Airport Station and the last station in the local fare zone. Its parking is managed by Denver International Airport.

stations.name: 40th / Colorado
stations.description: 40th / Colorado Station serves the Elyria-Swansea neighborhood of Denver. It features an art installation named Hands On created by Erik Carlson.

stations.name: Florida
stations.description: Florida Station is served by the R Line. H Line service is suspended during the Downtown Rail Reconstruction Project.

stations.name: Arapahoe at Village Center
stations.description: Arapahoe at Village Center Station serves the Fiddler's Green Amphitheatre and has an art installation, Nucleus, by Michael Clapper.

stations.name: Colorado
stations.description: Colorado Station serves the Colorado Center. It has an art installation named Big Boots created by Ries Niemi.

stations.name: Nine Mile
stations.description: Nine Mile Station serves as a transit hub for southeast Denver and south Aurora. There are buses that provide service to Denver International Airport that is often faster than the R Line.

stations.name: Lakewood-Wadsworth
stations.description: Lakewood-Wadsworth Station is the primary light rail station serving Lakewood, Colorado. It is located on an overpass of Wadsworth Blvd, allowing pedestrians to exit and enter from either side of the road. Recently, it has spurred transit-oriented development, and is a popular park and ride for residents going to sports events and downtown Denver.

stations.name: Eastlake / 124th Ave
stations.description: Eastlake / 124th Ave Station serves as the terminus for the N Line.

stations.name: Southmoor
stations.description: Southmoor Station serves South Denver and acts as the transfer point to the I-225 Corridor.

stations.name: Decatur-Federal
stations.description: Decatur-Federal Station serves a mixed commercial and residential area. The Colorado Department of Transportation is headquartered at Decatur-Federal, and the station serves Empower Field at Mile High and is a notable bus terminus.

stations.name: Theatre District-Convention Center
stations.description: Theatre District-Convention Center Station serves the Colorado Convention Center and the Denver Performing Arts Complex. It replaced the 14th & California and 14th & Stout stations.

stations.name: Englewood
stations.description: Englewood Station serves the Englewood Civic Center and sits at the interchange between US 85 and US 285, both of which are suburban freeways.

stations.name: Belleview
stations.description: Belleview Station serves the Denver Tech Center. It has an art installation called Thunder over the Rockies, created by Richard C. Elliott.

stations.name: Federal Center
stations.description: Federal Center Station serves the nearby Federal Center and CommonSpirit St. Anthony Hospital, which is a level 1 trauma center. It is the last station of double track before the W Line switches to single track for the final stretch to Jefferson County Government Center/Golden Station.

stations.name: Lincoln
stations.description: Lincoln Station serves some office buildings off of I-25, but primarily serves as a park and ride.

stations.name: Jefferson County Government Center/Golden
stations.description: Jefferson County Government Center/Golden Station serves the nearby community of Golden, including the Colorado School of Mines. In partnership with the City of Golden, Mines operates a transit shuttle called the Ore Cart that takes passengers from Jefferson County Government Center to downtown Golden and the Mines campus.

stations.name: Olde Town Arvada
stations.description: Olde Town Arvada Station serves the Olde Town Arvada shopping area.

stations.name: Ridgegate Parkway
stations.description: Ridgegate Parkway Station is planned to serve the Ridgegate development, a large mixed-use community spanning 3,500 acres.

stations.name: Littleton-Downtown
stations.description: Littleton / Downtown Station serves downtown Littleton. It was historically a depot for the Denver & Rio Grande Railroad's Royal Gorge Route.

stations.name: Sheridan
stations.description: Sheridan Station serves the border of Lakewood and Denver along Sheridan Blvd. It is near Sloan's Lake and has a large park and ride garage.

stations.name: Oak
stations.description: Oak Station serves a mixed commercial area of Lakewood, near the Lakewood Tech Center. It has spurred some transit-oriented development and serves as a bus transfer point.

stations.name: University of Denver
stations.description: University of Denver Station serves the University of Denver and the surrounding University Park neighborhood.

stations.name: Ball Arena / Elitch Gardens
stations.description: Ball Arena / Elitch Gardens Station serves the area directly west of Union Station, including Ball Arena and Elitch Gardens.

stations.name: Thornton Crossroads / 104th Ave
stations.description: Thornton Crossroads / 104th Ave Station serves Thornton at Colorado Boulevard and 104th Boulevard.

stations.name: Iliff
stations.description: TODO: Add station description.

stations.name: County Line
stations.description: County Line Station serves the Park Meadows mall, though it did not have direct pedestrian access to the mall for 2 years after its construction. It features a sculpture named Plow created by Emmett Culligan.

stations.name: Aurora Metro Center
stations.description: Aurora Metro Center Station serves the Town Center at Aurora mall and the Aurora Municipal Center.

stations.name: Lamar
stations.description: Lamar Station serves a residential area of Lakewood, with some transit-oriented development nearby.

stations.name: Dry Creek
stations.description: Dry Creek Station serves a commercial-heavy area of Centennial. It has an art installation of a series of hourglasses containing pyrite that is named Fools Gold, created by John McEnroe.

stations.name: Empower Field at Mile High
stations.wikipedia: en:Empower Field at Mile High station
stations.description: Empower Field at Mile High Station serves the nearby stadium of the same name, which is home to the Denver Broncos.

stations.name: Wheat Ridge / Ward
stations.description: Wheat Ridge / Ward Station serves the west side of Wheat Ridge. It is the proposed site of a major transit-oriented development.

stations.name: Garrison
stations.description: Garrison Station serves a primarily residential area.

stations.name: Louisiana-Pearl
stations.description: Louisiana-Pearl Station serves the Platt Park neighborhood and is partially underground. It has a kinetic sculpture named Strange Machine created by Ira Sherman.

stations.name: Knox
stations.description: Knox Station serves a primarily residential area in Denver's Villa Park neighborhood, and has spurred transit-oriented development nearby.

stations.name: Colfax
stations.description: Colfax Station serves the Anschutz health campus, including the UCHealth University of Colorado Hospital and Children's Hospital Colorado.

stations.name: Evans
stations.description: Evans Station serves the Overland neighborhood at US 85.

stations.name: Original Thornton / 88th Ave
stations.description: Original Thornton / 88th Station serves the area of Thornton near 88th Avenue and Welby Road.

stations.name: Commerce City / 72nd Ave
stations.description: Commerce City / 72nd Ave Station serves a primarily industrial area with some bus connections.

stations.name: Northglenn / 112th
stations.description: Northglenn / 112th Station serves Northglenn. During its construction, a trestle bridge from 1909 was discovered, but it was determined not to be of historical value and destroyed.

stations.name: Dayton
stations.description: Dayton Station is primarily interesting because it is located in the median of Interstate 225.

stations.name: Arvada Ridge
stations.description: Arvada Ridge Station serves western Arvada, Colorado, with service to Red Rocks Community College's Arvada campus. It features an art installation called Chromatic Harvest.

stations.name: 41st / Fox
stations.description: 41st / Fox Station serves the Globeville and Sunnyside neighborhoods of Denver.

stations.name: Yale
stations.description: Yale Station serves the Holly Hills area of Denver.

stations.name: Orchard
stations.description: Orchard Station serves Greenwood Village. It has an art installation of stamped concrete called Orchard Memory, created by Wopo Holup.

stations.name: 60th / Sheridan - Arvada Gold Strike
stations.wikipedia: en:List of Denver RTD rail stations
stations.description: TODO: Add station description.

stations.name: Perry
stations.description: Perry Station serves a suburban area of west Denver. It has some transit-oriented development.

stations.name: Oxford-City of Sheridan
stations.description: Oxford-City of Sheridan Station serves the border of Sheridan and Englewood.

stations.name: 30th & Downing
stations.description: 30th & Downing Station is a light rail station in Denver and the L Line terminus. It has no active rail service while the L Line is suspended.

stations.name: 48th Ave/Brighton Blvd @ Nat`L Western Ctr
stations.description: TODO: Add station description.

stations.name: Westminster
stations.description: Westminster Station serves Westminster and is the northern terminus of the B Line, though there are plans to extend the B Line to Boulder and Longmont. It has an art installation called Grotto by Brian W. Brush.

stations.name: Clear Creek / Federal
stations.description: Clear Creek / Federal Station serves the unincorporated community of Berkley. It has RTD's largest piece of public art, Addison Karl's mural Doradus.

stations.name: 2nd Ave & Abilene
stations.description: 2nd Ave & Abilene Station serves a residential area along I-225.

stations.name: Sky Ridge
stations.description: Sky Ridge Station serves the Sky Ridge Medical Center.

stations.name: Pecos Junction
stations.description: Pecos Junction Station is the last station that the B and G Lines share and it is one of the least used stations in the RTD network.

stations.name: Red Rocks College
stations.description: Red Rocks College Station serves as a midpoint between Federal Center Station and Jefferson County Government Center/Golden Station. It serves the Red Rocks Community College Lakewood campus.

stations.name: 13th Ave
stations.description: 13th Ave Station serves Aurora and is planned to be the center of a future transit-oriented development.

stations.name: Fitzsimons
stations.description: Fitzsimons Station serves the University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus. It retains the name of the former Fitzsimons Army Medical Center.

stations.name: 25th & Welton
stations.description: 25th & Welton Station is a light rail station in downtown Denver, east of the Downtown loop.

stations.name: 20th & Welton
stations.description: 20th & Welton Station is a light rail station in downtown Denver, east of the Downtown loop.

stations.name: 27th & Welton
stations.description: 27th & Welton Station is a light rail station in downtown Denver, east of the Downtown loop.

stations.name: Lone Tree City Center
stations.wikipedia: en:List of Denver RTD rail stations
stations.description: Lone Tree City Center Station serves a field. It is by far the least used RTD station with an average of 20 passengers, zero parking spots, and nothing interesting nearby. It is planned to host transit-oriented development, but no such plans have been created since its opening in 2019.
